units.text: INT. VICTORIAN PHOTOGRAPHER'S STUDIO - DAY
A high glass roof throws white light on a painted backdrop of a Roman ruin.
A wooden camera on a tripod, its black cloth hanging.
Plaster columns, a wicker chair, a potted palm.
The room smells of chemicals and dust.
PROFESSOR ALARIC FENWICK, 60s, the photographer, in a velvet smoking jacket and a skullcap, ducks beneath the cloth and adjusts a brass lens.
Frail and exacting.
LADY CORDELIA VANE, 50s, in a stiff black silk gown, sits in the wicker chair with hands folded in her lap.
Her jaw is a drawn line.
Behind her, CAPTAIN EDMUND VANE, 50s, her husband, stands in dress uniform with medals pinned to his chest.
His posture is perfect.
His eyes are far away.
A little to the left, Lady Vane.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: I am quite comfortable here.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: The light, my lady.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: The light will survive.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Captain Vane, perhaps you might lean forward.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: I prefer to stand as I am.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: Of course.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: He emerges, dusts his hands, and examines them both with the squint of a man arranging a bouquet.
You are, if I may, rather stiff.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: We are celebrating thirty years, Professor.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Then smile.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: We are not a smiling family.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Cordelia.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: Edmund.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: A silence.
The camera ticks as the shutter cools.
Fenwick pretends to adjust the lens.
I have photographed many couples, my lady. Some embrace, some glare, some stare at the ceiling. The photograph keeps everything.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: Does it?
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: Every shadow.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: Let it keep this one, then.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: He lays his hand upon her shoulder.
She stiffens.
Then, very slightly, leans into it.
Hold that.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: Do not tell us when.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: I never do.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: A bright puff of magnesium.
White light floods the studio.
When it fades, they have not moved.
Edmund's hand is still on her shoulder.
Edmund, you may remove your hand now.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: I think I shall not.
units.name: EDMUND
